note: Triennial election of the 19 electoral divisions of Dungannon rural district, one member each. Nominations closed on 17 May 1955 and there were no contests: '13 Unionists and six Nationalists were returned unopposed' (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1955, p. 8). No poll was held; Tyrone's polling day was Thursday 2 June 1955. At the new council's first meeting Mr. M. Busby was re-elected chairman and Hugh M'Ilgorm, John Nimmons and Samuel Morrow were co-opted (Mid-Ulster Mail, 18 June 1955, p. 2). Thomas Loughran was one of three Nationalist newcomers returned unopposed, for Altmore. Returned unopposed.
